title: Osiris Shaft water samples tested with the Osirion 7 mission
summary: Jeffrey Drum tells of Osiris Shaft water samples tested with the Osirion 7 mission, about 2020s at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we've actually taken samples of the water in the Osiris Shaft and I had that tested in conjunction with an archaeological project that I'm a member of called the Osirion 7 archaeological mission in conjunction with Jim Westerman to investigate the source of the water within the Osirion.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum says that sometime in the 2020s he took samples of the water in the Osiris Shaft, a deep water-filled shaft under the Giza plateau in Egypt, near the pyramids. He says he had the water tested as part of an archaeological project he belongs to, the Osirion 7 mission, which he runs with a man named Jim Westerman to find where the water in the Osirion, an ancient Egyptian temple, comes from. Drum tells it on a podcast about the idea that a huge energy system lies beneath the pyramids, and the water tests are part of his case for it.
